newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's Islamists say Hamas supporter tortured.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's Islamists say Hamas supporter tortured.

text.p: Jordan's Islamic parliamentary party said on Wednesday that Jordanian intelligence services this month detained and tortured a supporter of the Moslem movement Hamas.
The Islamic Action Front (IAF) said Essam al-Najjar was summoned by officials on August 31.

"He was immediately detained and subjected to interrogation, and physical and mental torture," the party said in a faxed statement. He was held for two weeks before the intervention of two IAF parliamentarians, it added.
Jordanian officials were not immediately available to comment on the IAF statement.
It said Najjar was beaten in the stomach, throat and on the soles of his feet and guards cursed him and wiped excrement in his face.

The IAF, which holds 16 seats in Jordan's 80-seat parliament, said it was distributing the statement to other deputies so they could see "the truth about what is happening in the intelligence services".

Jordan denies that it has any official Hamas representation on its territory but many Jordanians, particularly those of Palestinian origin, have strong sympathies with Hamas and see it as a symbol of opposition to Israel.
